annotations.text:
What the pruning does — DISPLAY only, nothing leaves the store:

· Only the fields Texas actually speaks to render as cards (grounds split into the two § 552.267 rules, each with its own must/may verb and rule id).

· The twice-homed money pair (estimate $40 / deposit $100) stops being editable here — one pointer card to the fee schedule, its single home.

· 'Settled elsewhere' names the two facts that look missing but run from the payment rules.

· The 14 silent slots collapse to one line, expandable; the one engine-wired guardrail stays visible.

State-generic by construction: 'silent' = a field whose imported provenance carries no citation — computed per state, never hardcoded to Texas. Illinois would show its forfeiture and purpose rules as cited cards; Washington its 10% deposit cap.

Honesty note: the import currently files the pay-or-abandon window fields as null (with § 552.221(e) cites). The card here is drawn with the law's figures (10 bd / 60 d) — same numbers the fee-law screen already shows. Build choice: render from the template's figures, or have the reconciler fill the fields on import. Your call.
